independence: same-family/provisional; not an externally attested independent review

blocking_findings.title: Every run mode fails the primary-threshold assertion
blocking_findings.evidence: The spec stores a descriptive string in primary_threshold; the entrypoint requires numeric 0.5. Evaluation of this exact AST assertion against the sealed JSON returned false, without importing the training code.
blocking_findings.impact: preflight, train, initial_formal and formal all stop before constructing their dataset/runner; the check occurs after model loading and CUDA initialization.
blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Restore primary_threshold to numeric 0.5. Keep the strict-gate/wide-first policy in selection_rule or a separately named policy field. Reseal and review the revised spec.

blocking_findings.title: The required new-objective preflight witnesses are absent
blocking_findings.evidence: preflight computes the matched objective, adds the selected-query objective, and checks gradients of their sum on head parameters. No isolated gradient with respect to corrected Query-mask logits is checked. The native reconciliation only checks the matched loss. The branch that skips already matched queries is present in selected_query_mask_objective.py:18, but preflight has no executable witness showing the extra objective's direct gradient excludes matched-root, matched-other and all nonselected queries or that an ineligible row contributes exactly zero.
blocking_findings.impact: A preflight can report status=pass even if the new extra term is ineffective or its direct gradient support violates the declared responsibility rule; native matched loss alone can satisfy the current parameter-gradient assertions. This does not prove the present selected loss formula is wrong, but leaves the explicitly required sanity gate incomplete.
blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Before backward during actual B8 preflight, isolate the extra objective and assert its direct gradient support on the corrected mask logits: only the native-bbs-selected unmatched Query may receive nonzero gradient; matched-root/matched-other rows and every nonselected Query must receive zero. Reconcile the extra scalar using root GT majority-superpoint masks, coefficients [5,1,10,2], and actual batch size. Record observed eligibility/role counts and do not claim an unobserved branch was exercised. Keep these as preflight checks, with no preflight optimizer state carried into fit.

nonblocking_findings.title: Treatment logging retains a matched-only zero-expansion field
nonblocking_findings.evidence: matched_mask_loss returns expanded_positive_queries=0 and loss equal to the matched loss. The same record becomes arms.selected_query after the extra objective is added; those fields are not renamed or updated. The top-level expansion map and nested selected_query_objective are correct, so the training expression itself is unaffected.
nonblocking_findings.minimal_fix: Make the component scope explicit (for example matched_loss and matched_expanded_positive_queries), or update the treatment record with total_loss and its actual extra_rows. Preserve the separately reconciled native component.

checks.detail: The pinned warm path/hash matches the current archived content best with 7446 support updates. Both independent heads receive the same nonzero state; optimizers are fresh AdamW instances. The inherited zeroing of the last nine input columns is a no-op for the pinned content lineage: that lineage starts those columns at zero and trains only zero geometry inputs. No pickle was read here, so actual tensor equality remains a runtime obligation.

preflight returns without saving weight files; a separate train invocation recreates warm heads and optimizers. The reviewed entrypoint does not itself enforce the preceding source/preflight receipts; the launch workflow must do so.

One frozen parent forward feeds both heads. Geometry and the zero-output readback remain frozen; semantic logits are copied from the one native head invocation. The train loss uses only Query/fused Mask terms; no ranking, quality or score loss is added. All 256 candidates remain.

Selection uses native_root_bbs then descending argsort, matching the sealed official bbs evaluator formula. Native assignments are computed once from frozen uncorrected-parent outputs and retained for both arms. Extra supervision skips any query matched to any target, including root and other instances.

The verified dataset mirror puts ScanRefer target_id first, appends an auxiliary anchor only afterward, and builds point masks from scan object membership. Targets therefore use real root GT slot 0. Both objectives threshold scatter_mean at >0.5. The extra terms are [5,1,10,2], one selected unmatched Query maximum per expression, divided by len(indices), including ineligible rows as zero. The final B2 minibatch is normalized by 2, not 8.

content and selected_query use the same 27841-parameter, 10-state-tensor corrector with geometry disabled. Factory supports both current checkpoint arm names and geometry_encoding=zero. The inherited signed-log branch is unreachable for these arms and is not an active treatment difference.

The preflight code reconstructs all 1314 CPU tensors and compares every state tensor, restores actual AdamW states on CPU and GPU, and compares the installed native-forward head with the paired path on captured identical inputs. It checks exact Mask/Box/score outputs and one native semantic-head call. This is not a full cold GPU-parent reconstruction; the receipt explicitly says so.

At step 0 the two warm arms' masks, boxes and scores are directly compared; masks are also compared to a head loaded from the unmodified historical warm state. Box equivalence to that historical head follows from those identical masks and the same frozen reference path; no separate full historical GPU forward is performed.

All nine Python files parse and match new_runner_files. All 17 helper files match the spec in the existing local runtime bundle. Native losses/PV source match the pinned source_port manifest. The dataset mirror matches its source manifest, and the official evaluator matches native_evaluator_sha256. No new third-party dependency or runtime rebuild is introduced.

seed=2027, batch=8, LR=1e-5, WD=.0005, clip=.1; one exact 29778-row fit pass, 3723 updates, final batch 2, cumulative support updates 11169. The train path no longer runs initial or terminal 6887-row validation. initial_formal remains an explicitly callable legacy mode but is not called by train.

Formal mode reconstructs the current terminal heads, verifies checkpoint lineage and exactly-once fit IDs, then evaluates all 9508 rows using the pinned native evaluator. Row records and all256 box/score arrays support later audit; computed strict/wide counts are reconciled to evaluator detections. Historical 5599/4859 is labeled historical and no new initial accuracy is claimed.

7446 denotes prior support updates and 11169 denotes terminal support updates; local round step3723 remains correct. retained_hidden_prior_updates=11169 belongs to the inherited selected geometry checkpoint lineage, not an additional new support run. No active box_conditioned arm or signed_log payload remains. The matched-only zero expansion field remains ambiguous as W1.

limitations: Source gate only: no empirical sanity, checkpoint load, result audit, metric or performance claim was performed.

The source runner expects output/content and output/selected_query directories to exist before save at paired_support_loop.py:185; the deployment launcher is outside this review and must provision them.
The launcher must bind the revised spec/source seals and passed actual preflight before invoking train. The entrypoint itself does not read a prior preflight receipt.
Remote runtime/data existence was not probed; local source mirrors and manifests were checked only.
C3 remains a hypothesis under separate novelty review; this report establishes neither novelty nor three effective contributions.
disposition: Fix B1 and complete B2 in the isolated source, refresh seals, obtain a new source review, then run actual B8 sanity. Do not treat this R1 report as an authorization or actual-result PASS.
